python3 << 'PY'
import os
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/steven/.agent-skills/skills")

# Top-level listing
entries = sorted(os.listdir(ROOT), key=str.lower)
n_dir = n_file = n_link = n_other = 0
top_links = []
top_files = []
top_dirs = []
hidden = []

for name in entries:
    p = ROOT / name
    if name.startswith('.'):
        hidden.append(name)
    try:
        st = os.lstat(p)
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"LSTAT_ERR {p}: {e}")
        continue
    is_link = os.path.islink(p)
    is_dir = os.path.isdir(p)  # follows link
    is_file = os.path.isfile(p)
    if is_link:
        n_link += 1
        target = os.readlink(p)
        top_links.append((name, target, "dir" if is_dir else ("file" if is_file else "other")))
    elif is_dir:
        n_dir += 1
        top_dirs.append(name)
    elif is_file:
        n_file += 1
        top_files.append(name)
    else:
        n_other += 1

print("=== TOP-LEVEL COUNTS ===")
print(f"total_entries={len(entries)}")
print(f"real_directories={n_dir}")
print(f"regular_files={n_file}")
print(f"symlinks={n_link}")
print(f"other={n_other}")
print(f"hidden={len(hidden)} {hidden}")
print(f"root_is_symlink={os.path.islink(ROOT)}")
print()
print("=== TOP-LEVEL FILES ===")
for f in top_files:
    print(f"FILE {ROOT/f}")
print()
print("=== TOP-LEVEL SYMLINKS ===")
for name, target, kind in top_links:
    print(f"LINK {ROOT/name} -> {target} ({kind})")
print()
print("=== FIRST 20 DIRS ===")
for d in top_dirs[:20]:
    print(d)
print(f"... {len(top_dirs)} real dirs total")
PY
